findings.title: Website is unreachable over HTTPS
findings.explanation: The site refused the connection when we tried to reach it over HTTPS, and the TLS check separately timed out trying to connect. This means visitors cannot currently load the website at all. DNS resolution still works and points to an IP address, so the server itself appears to be down, blocking the port, or misconfigured, rather than the domain being unregistered.
findings.recommendation: Check that the web server process and firewall on the host at 203.0.113.200 are running and accepting connections on ports 80/443, and restart the service or hosting instance if needed.

findings.title: Unable to verify TLS certificate status
findings.explanation: We could not check whether the site's TLS/SSL certificate is valid or expiring because the connection timed out before any certificate could be retrieved. Until the site is reachable again, there is no way to confirm the certificate is in good standing, which is a risk in itself since an expired or misconfigured certificate would also block visitors.
findings.recommendation: Once server connectivity is restored, re-run a TLS check to confirm the certificate is valid and not close to expiring.

findings.title: No SPF or DMARC email authentication records found
findings.explanation: The domain has no SPF or DMARC TXT records set up. Without these, it's easier for attackers to send spoofed emails that appear to come from this domain, and legitimate email may be more likely to land in spam.
findings.recommendation: Add an SPF record and a DMARC TXT record for the domain to help mail providers verify legitimate email and reject spoofed messages.
